verdict.rationale: Lindy is itself the built-in AI assistant. Its docs describe delegating tasks to it directly: it handles email, meetings and scheduling in Slack DMs, takes requests over iMessage/SMS, answers ad-hoc research tasks, and runs routines on autopilot, with guardrails and draft approval keeping the user in control. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Lindy works over both iMessage and SMS, so you can delegate to your AI assistant right from your phone.
Zero setup. Lindy handles email, meetings, and scheduling right in your DMs.
Lindy combines your work context (emails, meetings, calendar) with deep web research to give you thorough, relevant answers.
set a schedule or trigger once, and Lindy runs the whole job for you on autopilot
